name: Magmadar
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 1,541 to 2,441 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.38 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 30 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2024-12-12 to 2025-02-28): the median of 607 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (1,954), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (607 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,270 weapon damage, spread 0.709, a 1.15 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 53 s (10th to 90th percentile 42 to 67). Abilities: Lava Breath 19272 1,157 to 1,343 Fire, frontal (the Classic Era client's spell data; a 2006 Molten Core log from Blizzard's servers, in WWS format, had it at 624 average). Its timer is assumed: the cmangos script triggers it with Frenzy.
abilitiesSource: Lava Breath 19272 1,157 to 1,343 Fire, frontal (the Classic Era client's spell data; a 2006 Molten Core log from Blizzard's servers, in WWS format, had it at 624 average). Its timer is assumed: the cmangos script triggers it with Frenzy.
notes: Frenzy (+150% attack speed for 8 s) is in the logs' swing rate, as much of it as the raids let through. Magma Spit (a Fire DoT on attackers), Panic (fear) and Lava Bomb are left out. Lava Breath's timer is assumed (the script triggers it with Frenzy in cmangos).

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (30 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 8 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 2,065 a second with overheal and absorbs (27% of the heals effective), 2.62 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 590 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (1% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 30.
